dialogue.content: おつかれさまです。よろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。本日よろしくおねがいいたします
dialogue.English: Hello. I look forward to working with you today.

dialogue.content: よろしくです！
dialogue.English: You too!

dialogue.content: お時間早いですが準備がよければはじめさせていただいてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It's a little early, but if you're ready, shall we begin?

dialogue.content: はい、始めて頂いて大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: Yes, please go ahead and start.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm the counselor.

dialogue.content: こんにちは
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: 本日はご相談いただきありがとうございます。どのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for reaching out today. How can I help you?

dialogue.content: はい、会社に行くのが毎日おっくうなんです
dialogue.English: Well, I dread going to work every day.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね....毎朝おつらい思いですね
dialogue.English: I see... That must be difficult for you every morning.

dialogue.content: いつころからそのような感じですか？
dialogue.English: How long have you been feeling that way?

dialogue.content: 3ヶ月ほど前からずっとです
dialogue.English: It's been going on for about three months now.

dialogue.content: ３ヶ月も頑張ってお仕事にいってらっしゃったんですね「
dialogue.English: You've been pushing yourself to go to work for three months, then.

dialogue.content: ３ヶ月前は特におっくうお気持ちはなかったかんじですか？
dialogue.English: And before these three months, you didn't particularly feel this reluctance?

dialogue.content: そうですね、今の仕事はまだ半年くらいなのですが
dialogue.English: That's right. I've only been at my current job for about six months.

dialogue.content: はじめは試用期間として時給で
dialogue.English: Initially, it was a probationary period on an hourly wage.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 3ヶ月前に正社員になった頃から、なんだかおっくうになってきました
dialogue.English: Ever since I became a full-time employee three months ago, it's somehow started to feel like a chore.

dialogue.content: 今は正社員としてお勤めされているんですね。
dialogue.English: So you're working as a full-time employee now.

dialogue.content: はい、そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s right.

dialogue.content: 正社員になってから何かきっかけがあったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Was there anything in particular that happened after you became a full-time employee?

dialogue.content: うーん
dialogue.English: Hmm...

dialogue.content: 思い当たるようなことはないかんじですかね
dialogue.English: Does nothing specific come to mind?

dialogue.content: 差し支えなければ今のお仕事はどんなことをされていらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: If you don't mind my asking, what kind of work do you do?

dialogue.content: そうですね、何かある気もしますが、わかりません
dialogue.English: Well, I feel like there might be something, but I’m not sure.

dialogue.content: 会計事務所で働いています
dialogue.English: I work at an accounting firm.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お忙しい職場なんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Is it a busy workplace?

dialogue.content: 案件が多くて忙しいです
dialogue.English: We have a lot of cases, so it's busy.

dialogue.content: それは大変ですね
dialogue.English: That must be tough.

dialogue.content: ご相談者さままだ正社員になったばかりですが、他のみなさんもお忙しく働いていらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: You've only just become a full-time employee, but is everyone else busy at work as well?

dialogue.content: はい、みなさんお忙しい感じです
dialogue.English: Yes, everyone seems busy.

dialogue.content: なるほどみなさんが忙しいところでお勤めでいらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.English: I see, so you're working in a place where everyone is busy.

dialogue.content: ご相談者さまがお仕事で今困っていらっしゃることなどあるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything you're currently struggling with at work?

dialogue.content: 仕事内容に関しては、わからないことも多いですがそれなりに楽しんでいます
dialogue.English: As for the work itself, there are many things I don’t know yet, but I’m enjoying it reasonably well.

dialogue.content: ただ苦手な人がいまして
dialogue.English: It's just that there's someone I find difficult to work with.

dialogue.content: 楽しくお仕事ができていらっしゃって、お仕事が好きなんですね
dialogue.English: It sounds like you're able to enjoy your work, so you like your job, then.

dialogue.content: 苦手な人がいらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: There's someone you find difficult?

dialogue.content: はい、仕事自体は好きなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, I do like the work itself.

dialogue.content: 経営者なんですが
dialogue.English: It's the owner.

dialogue.content: ワンマンというか
dialogue.English: He’s rather autocratic.

dialogue.content: 経営者さんが苦手なんですね。
dialogue.English: So you find the owner difficult.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ワンマンだとやりづらいですね
dialogue.English: It must be hard to work with someone so autocratic.

dialogue.content: やりづらいです…
dialogue.English: It's very difficult...

dialogue.content: ワンマンになるときは具体的にはどんな感じですか？
dialogue.English: When he's being autocratic, what is it like specifically?

dialogue.content: いつも機嫌が悪い感じで
dialogue.English: He always seems to be in a bad mood.

dialogue.content: それは嫌なかんじですね
dialogue.English: That sounds unpleasant.

dialogue.content: そうですね、話をするのも嫌になってきます
dialogue.English: Yes, it makes me reluctant to even talk to him.

dialogue.content: 機嫌が悪いときご相談者さまに何か影響があることもあるんですか？
dialogue.English: When he's in a bad mood, does it ever affect you in any way?

dialogue.content: 私はパソコンにやや詳しいということで採用されまして
dialogue.English: I was hired because I’m somewhat knowledgeable about computers.

dialogue.content: すごいですね～
dialogue.English: That's impressive!

dialogue.content: 経営者がパソコン苦手なんですね
dialogue.English: The owner isn't very good with computers.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: で、何かあるたびにやらされるのです
dialogue.English: So, every time something comes up, I'm made to do it.

dialogue.content: 手こずると嫌味を言われます
dialogue.English: If I have trouble, he makes snide remarks.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。嫌味をいわれるなんて、、、
dialogue.English: I see. To have snide remarks made to you like that…

dialogue.content: おつらいですね
dialogue.English: That must be painful.

dialogue.content: 採用した意味がないとか…つらいです
dialogue.English: He says things like, "There was no point in hiring you." … It's painful.

dialogue.content: えーー、そんなこと言われるんですか。ひどいですねご自分のお仕事もあるなかでいろいろとやらされるのですか？
dialogue.English: Wow, he says things like that? That’s awful. On top of your own work, you’re made to do these various tasks as well?

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 手持ちの仕事ができないので、毎日サービス残業です
dialogue.English: I can't get my own work done, so I do unpaid overtime every day.

dialogue.content: それはご苦労されていますね、、、、昼間できず残業でおぎなっているのですね
dialogue.English: That must be very difficult for you. You can't finish your work during the day, so you make up for it with overtime.

dialogue.content: 残業は毎日どのくらいされているのですか？
dialogue.English: About how much overtime do you do each day?

dialogue.content: 毎日21時回るくらいに帰ります
dialogue.English: I go home around 9 p.m. every day.

dialogue.content: そんなに遅くまで･･･
dialogue.English: That late...

dialogue.content: 朝も早く出勤なんですか？
dialogue.English: Do you go in early in the morning as well?

dialogue.content: 朝は10時始業なので、そこだけは楽です
dialogue.English: Work starts at 10 a.m., so at least that part is easy.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。少しでもゆっくりできる時間があって安心いたしました
dialogue.English: I see. I'm relieved to hear you have some time to relax in the morning.

dialogue.content: 朝だけは早めに行くことはしていません
dialogue.English: At least I don't go in early in the morning.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。朝がゆっくりでよかったです。
dialogue.English: I see. I’m glad your mornings are relaxed.

dialogue.content: 職場の方はみなさん残業されているんですか？
dialogue.English: Does everyone at your workplace work overtime?

dialogue.content: はい、ベテランさんも21時くらいに外回りから帰ってくることがよくあります
dialogue.English: Yes, even the senior staff often get back from client visits around 9 p.m.

dialogue.content: そんなに遅くまでみなさんも頑張っていらっしゃるお仕事なんですね
dialogue.English: So it's a job where everyone works so hard until that late.

dialogue.content: そうですね…案件が多くて…
dialogue.English: Yes... we have so many cases...

dialogue.content: ご相談者さまは経営者の方のほかに苦手だったり、お困りのことはありますか？
dialogue.English: Besides the owner, is there anyone else you find difficult, or anything else you’re struggling with?

dialogue.content: 経営者以外はそこそこ人間関係はいいと思います
dialogue.English: Other than the owner, I think my relationships with my coworkers are pretty good.

dialogue.content: 経営者だけです
dialogue.English: It’s just the owner.

dialogue.content: よい職場なんですね。
dialogue.English: It sounds like a good workplace otherwise.

dialogue.content: 案件が多いとおっしゃられていたのですが、それをこなすのは大変なんですか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned you have a lot of cases. Is it difficult to handle them all?

dialogue.content: みんな経営者だけ、あまり相手にしないようにしているように、私には見えます
dialogue.English: It seems to me that everyone just tries not to engage with the owner too much.

dialogue.content: 他の方も経営者のことをあまりよく思っていらっしゃらないのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do the others not think very highly of the owner either?

dialogue.content: そうだと思います
dialogue.English: I think so.

dialogue.content: 嵐が過ぎるのを待つのがいいよって言われたこともありました
dialogue.English: Someone once told me it's best to just wait for the storm to pass.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。ご相談者さまやみなさんは、経営者の方のこと我慢してお仕事されているのですね
dialogue.English: I see. So you and your colleagues are enduring the owner's behavior while you work.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s right.

dialogue.content: 嵐が過ぎると機嫌はよくなるのですか？
dialogue.English: Does his mood improve after the storm passes?

dialogue.content: ならないことがほとんどです。機嫌がいいところをほとんど見たことがありません
dialogue.English: Hardly ever. I’ve almost never seen him in a good mood.

dialogue.content: 機嫌がいいときがほとんどないと、雰囲気も悪くなりますね
dialogue.English: If he's almost never in a good mood, that must create a bad atmosphere.

dialogue.content: 経営者の方がこのような感じでお仕事に影響がでることはありますか？
dialogue.English: Does his behavior affect the work in any way?

dialogue.content: 一度お客様に
dialogue.English: Once, a client...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 会計は別にあんたの事務所にお願いしなくてもいいんやでって言われまして
dialogue.English: told me, "We don't have to use your firm for our accounting, you know."

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: もちろん君の（私の）せいじゃないけどね、って言ってました
dialogue.English: He added, 'Of course, it’s not your fault.'

dialogue.content: 経営者はお客様からも信頼ないのかって…
dialogue.English: It made me wonder if the owner isn't trusted by his clients, either...

dialogue.content: なんだか悲しくなりました
dialogue.English: It made me feel kind of sad.

dialogue.content: お客様からも言われてしまうと、従業員の方もやる気なくしてしまいますよね
dialogue.English: Hearing that from a client must be very demotivating for the employees.

dialogue.content: たしかにそうかもしれません
dialogue.English: That might be true.

dialogue.content: 一生懸命されているのに、おつらいですよね。
dialogue.English: You're working so hard, so that must be painful for you.

dialogue.content: つらいですね
dialogue.English: It is painful.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: I can imagine.

dialogue.content: お話を少しまとめさせてもらってもいいですか？
dialogue.English: May I summarize what you've shared so far?

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: 相談者さまは、半年前からいまの会計事務所にお勤めになられています。３ヶ月前は試用期間でその後正社員として働いています
dialogue.English: You started working at your current accounting firm six months ago. You were on a trial period for the first three months and have been a full-time employee since then.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ３ヶ月ほど前から毎日仕事にいくことがおっくでいらっしゃいます。
dialogue.English: For the past three months, you've found it a chore to go to work every day.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お仕事は忙しいですが、好きな仕事なので楽しくやっています。が、
dialogue.English: The work is busy, but because you like the work, you enjoy it. However…

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 経営者の方が苦手です。
dialogue.English: ...you find the owner difficult to deal with.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That’s right.

dialogue.content: ご相談者さまはパソコンが達者ということで、パソコン苦手の経営者さんからいろいろやらされています。
dialogue.English: Because you're skilled with computers, the owner, who is not, has you do various computer-related tasks.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そのためご自分のお仕事に手が回らないこともあり、毎日２１時ころまで残業をされています
dialogue.English: As a result, you sometimes can’t get to your own work and end up working overtime until around 9 p.m. every day.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 職場の方も経営者を相手にしていなかったり、お客さまからも信用されていないかんじがあり、とても悲しい思いをされていらっしゃいますね。
dialogue.English: Your coworkers also seem to avoid the owner, and you get the sense that clients don’t trust him either, which makes you feel very sad.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: こんなかんじでよろしかったでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is that an accurate summary?

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, that's correct.

dialogue.content: お仕事一生懸命されていてとても頑張っていらっしゃるのに、経営者さまのことでいろいろと大変な思いをされていますよね
dialogue.English: You're working so hard, and yet you're going through so much trouble because of the owner.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's true.

dialogue.content: 一緒にどうしたらいいかお手伝いできればとおもいます
dialogue.English: I'd like to help you figure out what to do, if that's alright.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます、よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you, I'd appreciate that.

dialogue.content: ご相談者さまは、この経営者に求めること、改善してほしいことって何かありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything you'd like the owner to change or improve?

dialogue.content: 怒鳴ったり不機嫌な態度を改めて欲しいです
dialogue.English: I'd like him to stop yelling and change his grumpy attitude.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、、、不機嫌だとこちらも嫌な気持ちになりますよね
dialogue.English: I understand. When someone is grumpy, it makes you feel bad too, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: 腫れ物を触るような緊張感は疲れるからです
dialogue.English: Because the tension of walking on eggshells is exhausting.

dialogue.content: 怒鳴られることもあるのですか？
dialogue.English: Does he yell at you sometimes?

dialogue.content: はい、ミスがあるとたまにせきをきったように怒鳴ります
dialogue.English: Yes, if there's a mistake, he sometimes just erupts and starts yelling.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。急に怒られてしまうと、こちらも萎縮してしまいますよね
dialogue.English: I see. Being yelled at so suddenly must be intimidating, right?

dialogue.content: 怒鳴れない人には無視を決め込みます
dialogue.English: For people he can't yell at, he just gives them the silent treatment.

dialogue.content: それはひどいですね。
dialogue.English: That's awful.

dialogue.content: せめて不機嫌な態度だけでもなんとかしてほしいところです
dialogue.English: At the very least, I wish he would do something about his grumpy attitude.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。せめて態度を普通にしてほしいですよね
dialogue.English: I agree. At the very least, you just want him to act normally.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 機嫌が悪いときご相談者さまは、その上司への対応はどうされていますか？
dialogue.English: When he's in a bad mood, how do you handle interactions with him?

dialogue.content: 黙って聞いたり、謝ったりです
dialogue.English: I just listen quietly or apologize.

dialogue.content: 私から何も言うことはできないです、怖くて…
dialogue.English: I can't say anything to him... I'm too scared.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、、それ以上怒らせないようにしているかんじですよね
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like you're trying not to make him any angrier.

dialogue.content: そうですそうです
dialogue.English: Yes, exactly.

dialogue.content: またとばっちりいけても嫌ですよね
dialogue.English: You don't want to get caught in the crossfire, right?

dialogue.content: あー、とばっちりはみんな味わってると思います
dialogue.English: Ah, I think everyone gets caught in his crossfire.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。きっといつも嫌な思いをして我慢されていらっしゃいますよね。せっかく楽しくお仕事したいと思っていると感じます
dialogue.English: I understand. You must be enduring these unpleasant feelings all the time. I sense that you just want to be able to enjoy your work.

dialogue.content: ええ、その通りです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's exactly right.

dialogue.content: 提案ほどのことではないのですが、少し私の気持ちを話してもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: This isn't exactly a suggestion, but may I share a thought with you?

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: 経営者が機嫌が悪いのは、ご機嫌をとったりして直ることではないとおもいます
dialogue.English: I don’t think the owner’s bad mood is something that can be fixed by trying to placate him.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: Is that so?

dialogue.content: きげんの悪い問題は「その方の中」にあるとおもいます
dialogue.English: I believe the problem of his bad mood lies within him.

dialogue.content: たとえば、調子が悪いとか、いつも思うようにならないとか
dialogue.English: For example, he might not be feeling well, or perhaps things aren't going the way he wants.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ですが、経営者ご自身が機嫌が悪いことに気づかなければずっと続いてしまうような感じもします
dialogue.English: However, if the owner himself doesn't realize he's in a bad mood, I feel like this will continue indefinitely.

dialogue.content: なるほど…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: でもこのまま嫌な感じでお仕事するのはもっと辛いですよね
dialogue.English: But continuing to work in this unpleasant atmosphere must be even more difficult for you, right?

dialogue.content: 自分で気づいていないということですか
dialogue.English: Do you mean he isn't aware of it himself?

dialogue.content: 気づいていらっしゃいますかね？
dialogue.English: Do you think he's aware?

dialogue.content: 言われてみると
dialogue.English: Now that you mention it,

dialogue.content: 機嫌が悪いのはお前らのせいだとばかり言っています
dialogue.English: He's always saying it's our fault that he's in a bad mood.

dialogue.content: 俺は悪くないんだと言わんばかりで
dialogue.English: As if to say, ‘I’m not the one at fault.’

dialogue.content: ご相談者さまが直接でなくても経営者さんに冗談のように「今日は何か嫌なことでもあったんですか？」と軽く聞けるといいとおもったのですが、、、、
dialogue.English: I was thinking it might be good if you, or perhaps someone else, could casually ask him, almost as a joke, "Did something unpleasant happen today?" But perhaps not.

dialogue.content: なるほど…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: ご自分ではなく人のせいにしていらっしゃるのですね、、、、
dialogue.English: So he blames others instead of himself...

dialogue.content: 俺が悪いってことか？と凄まれた時があって
dialogue.English: There was a time he snapped at me, saying, 'Are you saying it's my fault?'

dialogue.content: もう何言ってもダメだってその時思いました
dialogue.English: At that moment, I thought, 'It's no use saying anything.'

dialogue.content: 確かに、そう思いますよねあとは「王様の耳はロバの耳」のように、同じ気持ちを持っている方とその思いを共有して気持ちを分かちあうという感じでストレス発散してみるというのはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I can certainly see why you'd think that. In that case, how about this? Like in the story 'The King Has Donkey's Ears,' you could try relieving stress by sharing and venting with others who feel the same way.

dialogue.content: そうですね、そういえば最近同僚とゆっくり話していませんでした
dialogue.English: You're right. Come to think of it, I haven't really talked with my colleagues lately.

dialogue.content: 経営者ご自身を変えることはもしかしたら難しいかもしれませんが、
dialogue.English: It might be difficult to change the owner himself, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 同僚と懇親を深めることと一緒に、経営者のことを吐き出してみてもいいかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: ...perhaps you could deepen your bonds with your colleagues and vent about the owner together.

dialogue.content: そうですね、ずっとひとりで悩んでいたと思います
dialogue.English: You're right. I think I've been struggling with this on my own.

dialogue.content: 明日同僚を酒に誘ってみます
dialogue.English: I'll ask a colleague to go for a drink tomorrow.

dialogue.content: いまなかなかお店にも行きづらいですが、ご相談者さまのお気持ちが少しでも軽くなることを願っております。
dialogue.English: I know it's difficult to go out right now, but I hope this helps lighten your spirits, even just a little.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます！
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you!

dialogue.content: そろそろお時間となりませいたので、ここらへんで終わらせていただきますが、本日のご相談はいかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: It's about time for us to finish, so we'll wrap up here. How was the session for you today?

dialogue.content: ↑なりました、です
dialogue.English: ↑ I meant to say "it has become time."

dialogue.content: 話を聞いて頂いてスッキリした気持ちです
dialogue.English: I feel relieved now that you've listened to me.

dialogue.content: ひとりで抱え込んでいたと思いました
dialogue.English: I realize now that I was bottling it all up.

dialogue.content: お話を聴かせていただきありがとうございました。お仕事楽しくできるといいですね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing with me. I hope you'll be able to enjoy your work.

dialogue.content: はい、仕事頑張ります
dialogue.English: Yes, I’ll do my best at work.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Thank you very much!

dialogue.content: 本日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうござました
dialogue.English: Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: (長い時間、ありがとうございました。)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for the long session.)

dialogue.content: （こちらこそです。おつかれさまでした！）
dialogue.English: (You too. Thank you for your hard work!)

dialogue.content: (とても勉強になりました。それでは、失礼いたします。)
dialogue.English: (This was very educational. Well then, I'll sign off now.)
